about: The music signal contract: one entry per thing the source of truth knows about a song (research/truth/). Each entry is a slot of music/MusicSignals.py, exposed at listener.signals.<name>. The human-readable contract is docs/contracts/music_analyzer_contract.md section 6. Tests keep this file, the code, the document and the truth files identical.
timing: Every signal describes the music at speaker time: what is being heard right now. The analyzer hears the music 5 seconds earlier and may use that future to decide.

kinds.event: true (or a strength above 0) on the single frame where the thing happens, otherwise false (or 0.0)
kinds.state: holds its value for as long as the thing lasts

status.bridged: filled today by Listener from a signal the sector already produces (named in 'source'); its quality is not measured yet
status.produced: filled by the production analyzer itself (the code is named in 'source'); it stays None until the first audio has reached the speakers; graded on the scoreboard, not rated by the owner yet
status.empty: the slot exists and answers None: nothing produces it yet

signals.name: beat
signals.meaning: A main beat falls on this frame: the pulse a person would tap.
signals.graded: found within 50 ms of a truth beat outside no-beat stretches: hits, misses, false alarms (F1)

signals.name: bpm
signals.meaning: Tempo in beats per minute, at the level a person would tap. Half and double count as wrong.
signals.graded: share of the time within 4% of the truth tempo; half and double reported apart

signals.name: no_beat
signals.meaning: There is no pulse to follow right now: free intro, talking, a passage out of time.
signals.graded: share of the time correct; delay at each edge

signals.name: bar_position
signals.meaning: Position in the bar of the latest beat. 1 is the first beat of the bar.
signals.graded: share of the beats carrying the right number

signals.name: beats_per_bar
signals.meaning: Number of beats in a bar.
signals.graded: share of the time equal to the truth

signals.name: beat_strength
signals.meaning: How hard the drums mark the latest beat.
signals.graded: follows the truth value beat by beat (correlation)

signals.name: kick
signals.meaning: A kick drum hit on this frame, with its strength.
signals.graded: found within 50 ms: hits, misses, false alarms (F1)

signals.name: snare
signals.meaning: A snare or clap hit on this frame, with its strength.
signals.graded: found within 50 ms: hits, misses, false alarms (F1)

signals.name: hat
signals.meaning: A hi-hat hit on this frame, with its strength.
signals.graded: found within 50 ms: hits, misses, false alarms (F1)

signals.name: tom
signals.meaning: A tom hit on this frame, with its strength.
signals.graded: found within 50 ms: hits, misses, false alarms (F1)

signals.name: cymbal
signals.meaning: A crash or ride cymbal hit on this frame, with its strength.
signals.graded: found within 50 ms: hits, misses, false alarms (F1)

signals.name: kick_present
signals.meaning: The kick drum keeps coming, whatever its pattern.
signals.graded: share of the time correct; delay at each edge

signals.name: kick_level
signals.meaning: Level of the low thump of the drums.
signals.graded: follows the truth curve (correlation) and its delay

signals.name: drop
signals.meaning: The music comes back at full power on this frame.
signals.graded: found within one beat: hits, misses, false alarms (F1)

signals.name: section_change
signals.meaning: The song moves to a new part on this frame.
signals.graded: found within one bar: hits, misses, false alarms (F1)

signals.name: breakdown
signals.meaning: The kick has left and will come back: the calm before the return.
signals.graded: share of the time correct; delay at each edge

signals.name: buildup
signals.meaning: Tension is rising toward a drop.
signals.graded: share of the time correct; delay at each edge

signals.name: riser
signals.meaning: The sound keeps getting brighter for several seconds: a sweep, a filter opening.
signals.graded: share of the time correct; delay at each edge

signals.name: silence
signals.meaning: Nothing is playing.
signals.graded: share of the time correct; delay at each edge

signals.name: bass_present
signals.meaning: A bass line is playing.
signals.graded: share of the time correct; delay at each edge

signals.name: drums_present
signals.meaning: Percussion is playing, kick or not.
signals.graded: share of the time correct; delay at each edge

signals.name: vocal_present
signals.meaning: Someone sings or speaks.
signals.graded: share of the time correct; delay at each edge

signals.name: other_present
signals.meaning: Instruments that are neither drums, bass nor voice are playing: guitars, synths, keyboards.
signals.graded: share of the time correct; delay at each edge

signals.name: bass_level
signals.meaning: Level of the bass line.
signals.graded: follows the truth curve (correlation) and its delay

signals.name: drums_level
signals.meaning: Level of the percussion.
signals.graded: follows the truth curve (correlation) and its delay

signals.name: vocal_level
signals.meaning: Level of the voice.
signals.graded: follows the truth curve (correlation) and its delay

signals.name: other_level
signals.meaning: Level of the other instruments.
signals.graded: follows the truth curve (correlation) and its delay

signals.name: layers
signals.meaning: How many of the four families (drums, bass, voice, other) are playing.
signals.graded: share of the time equal to the truth

signals.name: loudness
signals.meaning: How loud the whole music is.
signals.graded: follows the truth curve (correlation) and its delay

signals.name: band_sub
signals.meaning: Level of the deepest sounds, under 60 Hz.
signals.graded: follows the truth curve (correlation) and its delay

signals.name: band_bass
signals.meaning: Level of the bass range, 60 to 250 Hz.
signals.graded: follows the truth curve (correlation) and its delay

signals.name: band_mid
signals.meaning: Level of the middle range, 250 Hz to 4 kHz.
signals.graded: follows the truth curve (correlation) and its delay

signals.name: band_high
signals.meaning: Level of the treble, above 4 kHz.
signals.graded: follows the truth curve (correlation) and its delay

signals.name: brightness
signals.meaning: Whether the sound is dark (0) or bright (1).
signals.graded: follows the truth curve (correlation) and its delay

signals.name: fullness
signals.meaning: How much of the frequency range is busy: low when the music is sparse, high when everything plays.
signals.graded: follows the truth curve (correlation) and its delay

signals.name: chord
signals.range: a chord name such as G#:min, or N for no chord
signals.meaning: The chord being played.
signals.graded: share of the time with the right chord
